The issuer shows solid profitability (EBIT/Revenue implies a healthy ~13% EBIT margin) and moderate leverage (liabilities are ~52% of assets), with substantial equity cushioning (equity is ~48% of assets). However, liquidity is only modest (current ratio of 1.18), which limits the cushion against short-term stress. Overall this supports an upper investment-grade but not the highest tier credit profile.

DECISION: A-
